name: Tablet of the Seven
label: Quest
description: Tablet of the Seven: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I came to the Burning Steppes, following the legends of the Seven. They were dwarves of great knowledge and power, and if you have knowledge and power, then wealth is sure to follow.

If we can learn more of the Seven, then maybe we can get rich together. The ruins of Thaurissan is rumored to keep the Tablet of the Seven, which holds knowledge of the ancient dwarves. Find this tablet, copy its text and bring it to me. Let's discover its secrets together!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the writings of the Seven, friend? Have you learned the secrets from their tablet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you found the tablet! And your transcription is superb! Are you sure you're an adventurer and not a scribe?
Here you are, friend. Here is the payment I promised.
